messages:
anika: opened a small PR to tighten Dedicated provisioning docs: add runnable TF snippet, SDK examples, and clearer SLA blurb. PR: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/2660. Quick copy + snippet sanity check please.

mike: taking a look. please include a concrete account-label example for TF so customers can copy/paste. reviewers always ask for that.

sara: added Python + JS SDK snippets in the PR. Python sample: ```python
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(api_key=os.getenv('RW_KEY'))
res = client.dedicated.create_reservation(account_id='acme-edge', gpus=2, region='eu-west-1')
print(res)
```
Confirming method exists in v0.9.x.

docsbot: CI: lint OK. linkcheck: 1 broken path found -> old terraform-examples repo (reserved_pool.tf) returned 404.

josh: I'll update the TF path in the PR and add a short note about preemption: "burst instances are preemptible under host pressure; reserved pools are isolated for committed capacity." Also pushed an autoscale YAML sample with cooldowns and burst cap.

anika: for the handbook SLA line, legal wants explicit exclusions. Draft I put in PR: "99.9% monthly availability for Dedicated reserved pools during committed windows, subject to documented exclusions and service credit remedies." Legal, ok to sign off if we add exclusions?

legal: prefer that phrasing with explicit exclusions (force majeure, customer misconfig, scheduled maintenance with prior notice). Once those are inserted we'll sign off.

anika: great — adding exclusions now. tagging owners in PR (docs: anika, infra: mike, SDK: sara, ops: josh). will merge after infra + legal OK. :white_check_mark:
